resources.string: Save a portable encrypted file and restore it on another device. Keep your backup password safe: Open Auth cannot recover it.
Backup needs attention. Your local accounts are still available.
Backup selected. Unlock to preview its contents.
Use at least 12 characters. Spaces and letter case are preserved.
Use 8–128 digits. A PIN is easier to guess offline if someone obtains your backup. A long password is stronger.
Changing the password creates a new encryption key. Older files still require their original password.
HOTP accounts may need resynchronization with their services. Known local counters will not move backwards.
Replacement removes accounts and groups that are absent from this backup.
I understand and want to replace
Backup protection saved. You can now save an encrypted file.
Check the password or PIN length and format.
Cannot unlock this file. Check the password or PIN and the backup file.
The vault changed or locked. Open a new preview before restoring.
The operation could not finish. Check access to the file and try again.
Save a backup file after changing your accounts. Choose where to keep it.
